dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors to the National Museum of American History and operations of the Smithsonian Institution and National Park Service.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution shall collect, preserve, and display in the National Museum of American History artifacts

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a focused museum exhibition and counter-signage requirements related to specific recent presidential administrations.
dimensions.evidence: display in a permanent exhibition in the National Museum of American History artifacts reflecting the rise of governmental propaganda

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes an appropriation of $5,000,000 to the Smithsonian Institution, remaining available until expended.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Smithsonian Institution $5,000,000 to carry out this section

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific administrative and curation duties for the Smithsonian and National Park Service regarding public displays and signage.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the National Park Service (NPS), shall remove any signage

dimensions.assessment: Creates a permanent exhibition and ongoing signage mandates with funds remaining available until expended.
dimensions.evidence: display in a permanent exhibition in the National Museum of American History... to remain available until expended

missing_information: The exact total cost of National Park Service signage alterations is not specified beyond the Smithsonian appropriation.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Smithsonian Institution to establish a specific permanent exhibition and requires the National Park Service to alter or supplement certain signage, backed by a $5,000,000 authorization of appropriations.
